top_signals.title: ‘Accept Brexit and move on’, Theresa May warns Burnham
top_signals.summary: Former prime minister Theresa May has warned Andy Burnham must “accept Brexit and move on”. Speaking to the BBC, May said she was “aghast” that the prime minister could be considering rejoining the EU after he said at the Brussels summit this week he wanted to “brainstorm” ideas on the future of Britain’s relationship with [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
